notes.text: The William Davidson passages fully name Abba Yosef ben Dostai at Berakhot 28a and Rabbi Yaakov ben Dostai at Ketubot 111b. Rabbi Yehudah ben Dostai appears at Makkot 7a in that edition, beside Hyman’s retained 7b citation.

The third notice is at [Makkot 7a](https://www.sefaria.org/Makkot.7a.6) in the consulted text. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1628&lang=en) also cites 7a and identifies the authority quoted by Yehudah as Rabbi Shimon ben Shetach.
